blocks: The combined SSW owner's manual lists one jack — '8P8C Modular Jack (Also called RJ-45 Jack) for connecting Remote Control Model SSW-R1-12B' — and mentions no Modbus, RS-485 or RS-232 anywhere. The remote link format is unpublished.
sharedMapEvidence: One vendor manual (11002-SSW-350-600-1000-1500-2000-12A) covers all five ratings and describes a single SSW-R1-12B jack across them. Absence of a bus, shared.
gotchas: The retailer's 'digital remote on the 1500 W model' is right but under-stated: the manual says SSW-R1-12B is provided only for SSW-1000-12A, SSW-1500-12A and SSW-2000-12A. The SSW-600 sold here has no remote option.

12 V only across the whole SSW line, and modified... no — SSW is pure sine; SAM is the modified-sine line. Keep them apart when reading a retailer's page, the model prefixes are one letter different in feel and the waveform claim differs.
Same remote/switch interlock warning as NTX: leave the inverter's own switch OFF when the remote is wired.
